definition: Stable network-level identifier
comparison_note: Join key; may differ from public parent

definition: Reporting period end
comparison_note: Use for aggregate time series only

definition: Locations or premises disclosed as passed by fiber
comparison_note: May exceed the denominator if total consumer and business passings are reported

definition: Saleable locations aligned to the reported customer numerator
comparison_note: Preferred denominator for recalculation

definition: Fiber customers or connections in the stated scope
comparison_note: Scope is retained in customer_scope

definition: Penetration stated by the issuer
comparison_note: Preferred for presentation when company inputs are rounded

definition: Connections divided by aligned denominator
comparison_note: Audit field; blank when the issuer omits the denominator

definition: Age of the build cohort when measured
comparison_note: Best horizontal axis for true penetration curves

definition: Three times the quarter difference between observation date and launch quarter
comparison_note: No interpolation; observations are read directly from successive quarterly charts

definition: Passings in the stated vintage
comparison_note: Frontier vintages are cumulative; Shentel vintages are discrete

definition: Comparability grade from A through D
comparison_note: A is aligned and recurring; B has caveats; C is sparse; D is unusable

definition: Foreign key to the source ledger
comparison_note: Every observation must resolve to a primary company source

definition: Named balanced cohort set and maximum observed age
comparison_note: A panel holds its launch-cohort membership constant at every age

definition: Earliest discrete launch quarter included in the balanced panel
comparison_note: Inclusive panel boundary

definition: Latest discrete launch quarter included in the balanced panel
comparison_note: Inclusive panel boundary

definition: Sum of cohort penetration times reported cohort passings divided by total reported cohort passings
comparison_note: Preferred within a named balanced panel; use balanced_12m for 0/3/6/9/12-month benchmarking

definition: Quarter whose presentation contains the printed cohort bar
comparison_note: Retains repeated bars for auditability

definition: Quarter-end date represented by the presentation
comparison_note: Snapshot date; not necessarily the anniversary date of an older cohort bar

definition: Quarter-end when the cohort age was measured
comparison_note: Equals report_as_of for under-one-year bars; anniversary quarter-end for 12/24-month bars

definition: Whether the bar is current at report date or an anniversary milestone
comparison_note: Distinguishes early cohort readings from repeated historical milestones

definition: First loaded deck containing the distinct cohort-age point
comparison_note: Source lineage for deduplication

definition: Last loaded deck repeating the distinct cohort-age point
comparison_note: Source lineage for deduplication

definition: Number of loaded decks containing the same cohort-age point
comparison_note: Repeated values must reconcile exactly

definition: Calendar launch year used in company annual roll-up
comparison_note: Not interchangeable with a discrete quarterly launch cohort
